intro: Lesson 90: Understand angles as turns. To understand that an angle measures an amount of turn

questions.model: Teacher: anticlockwise from east goes to north.

questions.q: Face north, turn to south-east clockwise: how many right angles?
Face NW, turn 2 right angles clockwise?
Write the new direction: N + 1 right angle clockwise; E + half turn; S + 3 right angles anticlockwise.
How many right angles from NE to SW clockwise?
The minute hand turns from 12 to 9 clockwise. What fraction of a turn and how many right angles?
Big question: how much do we turn to face the qiblah?
questions.a: It depends where we start; the turn between our direction and the qiblah is an angle.
